{{Current events|year=2019|month=07|day=25|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Japan–North Korea relations]]
**[[North Korea]] tests two new missiles that land in the [[Sea of Japan]], though not within [[Japan]]ese territory. [[Minister of Defense (Japan)|Japanese Defense Minister]] [[Takeshi Iwaya]] condemns the testing as "extremely regrettable". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/07/north-korea-fires-unidentified-projectiles-south-korean-military-190724222529433.html (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.dw.com/en/north-korea-fires-missiles-into-sea-south-korea-military/a-49735180 (DW)]

;Health and environment
*[[July 2019 European heat wave]]
**A number of national maximum temperature records are broken, several surpassing records set the previous day: [[Germany]] sees {{convert|42.6|C|F}} at [[Lingen]], [[Belgium]] {{convert|41.8|C|F}} at [[Begijnendijk]] and [[The Netherlands]] {{convert|40.7|C|F}} at [[Gilze en Rijen]]. [https://www.accuweather.com/en/weather-news/scorching-heat-produces-all-time-record-highs-in-belgium-netherlands-as-western-europe-swelters-under-heat-wave/70008886 (Accuweather)] [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/live/2019/jul/25/heatwave-uk-weather-set-to-break-records-as-europes-cities-await-hottest-day-live (''The Guardian'')]
**The [[United Kingdom]] reports a temperature reading of {{convert|38.1|C|F}} in [[Cambridge]], the second highest UK temperature yet recorded.  It is subsequently confirmed that a reading of {{convert|38.7|C|F}} is verified, also in Cambridge, beating the previous record of {{convert|38.5|C|F}} set in [[Faversham]], [[Kent]] on 10 August 2003 to become the new national record. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2019/jul/29/met-office-confirms-new-uk-record-temperature-of-387c (''The Guardian'')]
**All-time records for various cities and towns in [[Western Europe]] are broken, most notably [[Paris]], reaching a temperature of {{convert|42.6|C|F}}. 

;Law and crime
*[[Capital punishment in the United States]]
**[[United States Attorney General|U.S. Attorney General]] [[William Barr]] resumes the federal usage of the death penalty. Five inmates are expected to be executed between December 2019 and January 2020. If carried out, these would be the first federal executions in the United States in sixteen years. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/07/25/william-barr-orders-first-federal-executions-in-nearly-two-decades.html (CNBC)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/07/25/us/capital-punishment-death-penalty.html (''The New York Times'')]
*At least four people are killed and two wounded in a shooting spree that spread across multiple [[Los Angeles]] neighborhoods. Police tackled and arrested the suspect, Gerry Zaragoza, after a 12-hour manhunt. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/07/25/us/los-angeles-shooting-spree/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.aol.com/article/news/2019/07/26/four-people-shot-dead-two-wounded-in-los-angeles-shooting-spree/23778943/ (Reuters via AOL.com)]

;Politics and elections
*The 92-year-old and first freely-elected [[President of Tunisia]], [[Beji Caid Essebsi]], dies. [[Assembly of the Representatives of the People|Tunisian parliament]] President [[Mohamed Ennaceur]] takes the role of interim president. [https://www.apnews.com/e907f5e7daf042cfb96d7d6fed9ee11e (Associated Press)], [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-49111905 (BBC News)]
*[[2019 Algerian protests]]
**[[Algeria|Algerian]] interim [[President of Algeria|president]] [[Abdelkader Bensalah]] appoints a six-member panel to set a presidential election date. The previous date of July 4 was cancelled due to lack of candidates amid mass protests. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-algeria-politics/algeria-names-panel-to-oversee-dialogue-hold-presidential-election-idUSKCN1UK2UJ (Reuters)]

;Sports
*Outfielder [[Stevie Wilkerson]] of the [[Baltimore Orioles]] becomes the first position player in [[Major League Baseball]] history to record a [[save (baseball)|save]], doing so in a 10–8 victory over the [[Los Angeles Angels]]. [https://www.cbssports.com/mlb/news/orioles-outfielder-stevie-wilkerson-throwing-50-mph-pitches-becomes-first-position-player-to-record-a-save/ (CBS)]
